description: Offered dedicated support to the Managing Director as well as other Executives when required, conducting research, issuing all corporate presentations, arranging meetings, appointments, and travel accommodations. Improved overall quality and efficiency.
Filtered Managing Director phone calls, managed his agenda and prepared correspondence as required. Communicated regularly with vendors and contractors scheduling meetings and addressing concerns.

Prepared the general requisition purchase order for stationary and organized the filing system in a timely manner. Prepared reports, conducted reconciliations, and resolved discrepancies. Balanced staff and Director's needs.
Organized, planned and supervised essential central services such as reception, security, maintenance, mail, as well as day-to-day running of the office.
Responsible for making sure that contracts, insurance requirements, and safety standards are correctly complied with. Managed 10 members of staff.

Developed and updated customer database for phone calls, product launches, events. Manage cash loss prevention procedures and established security policies and business plan. Kept senior management informed of changes in my areas of responsibility.

Analysed sales figures and forecasted future sales volumes. Involved in the recruitment, assessment, and interviewing of new staff. Managed and motivated staff to increase sales and ensure business efficiency. Produced reports on performance, then measured these against set indicators.

Acted as key person after office Director. Possessed touristic market knowledge as different booking & management systems: Global Amadeus, Sire (Spanish railway company booking system) & tour operator booking websites.

Managed intranet and accounting system. Accountable for commercial purposes, general administration tasks, and accountancy duties. Planning, organization and sale of all type of travels, packages, plane tickets, spectacles tickets, and private events.

matchmaking_summary: Natalia Garcia is a highly motivated and versatile professional with significant experience in strategic planning, sales management, general business administration, HR, operations planning, and coordination. Her ability to identify cost-effective strategies for promoting savings demonstrates strong analytical skills and financial acumen. With over ten years of experience across various roles including Assistant to Managing Director, Business Manager, and Travel Consultant, she has demonstrated her capacity as a leader and strategic thinker through efficient management practices that enhance organizational performance.
